notes.title: Playtest is now Live!
notes.content:
[b]Potential Issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Some permutations of leaving a game early and joining late may cause bugs or worst-case the game to freeze.
[*] There may be some weird behaviour when running the game at low frame rates.
[*] Host migration may not work consistently
[/list]

If you run into any bugs, please report it here:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeWwGKFPkxUEmW84zg9OuK1N8xo7P68QOc40fJn9DYLOh6MJA/viewform?usp=header]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeWwGKFPkxUEmW84zg9OuK1N8xo7P68QOc40fJn9DYLOh6MJA/viewform?usp=header[/url]

And we would appreciate hearing about your general feedback through this form:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefvw-krtn1ACLhcsckl7BMg7uhZ8_s1mPnBg6lsodSNH6mWA/viewform?usp=sharing]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefvw-krtn1ACLhcsckl7BMg7uhZ8_s1mPnBg6lsodSNH6mWA/viewform?usp=sharing[/url]

Thanks for playing!
